messages.content: 一輛汽車從靜止開始，10秒內行駛了120公尺的距離。在這段時間結束時，汽車的速度是多少？在達到這個速度後，汽車繼續加速5秒，從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍。最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍。在第二階段，汽車的加速度是多少？

function.name: kinematics_calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled. This is a float type value.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel. This is a float type value.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
We need to compute first part: car starts from rest, travels 120 m in 10 s. We need final speed after 10 s. Use kinematics: distance = v_i * t + 0.5 * a * t^2. v_i=0, so d = 0.5 a t^2 => a = 2d / t^2. Then final speed v_f = v_i + a t = a t. So v_f = (2d/t^2)*t = 2d/t. So v_f = 2*120/10 = 24 m/s. That is final speed after first 10s.

Now second stage: car continues accelerating for 5 seconds, starting from speed 12 m/s? Wait: "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" Means starting at 12 m/s and accelerate to final speed equal to twice the initial speed? But initial speed refers to what? It says "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍". So final speed after second stage is twice the speed computed in first part, i.e., 2 * 24 = 48 m/s. Starting speed for second stage is 12 m/s. So we have initial speed v_i2 = 12 m/s, final speed v_f2 = 48 m/s, time t2 = 5 s. Need acceleration a2 = (v_f - v_i)/t = (48-12)/5 = 36/5 = 7.2 m/s^2.

But check consistency: The statement "從12公尺/秒加速到最終速度是初始速度的兩倍" might mean starting at 12 m/s and final speed is twice the initial speed of the second stage? That would be 24 m/s. But then they say "最終速度是第一部分計算出的速度的兩倍" which is 48 m/s. So maybe they intend that the final speed after second stage equals twice the speed from first part (48). And starting speed is 12. So acceleration computed above.

Thus answer: first part final speed 24 m/s. Second part acceleration 7.2 m/s^2.

We can use function kinematics_calculate_acceleration to compute acceleration for second part. Provide initial_speed=12, final_speed=48, time=5. Also we could compute speed from rest but not needed.

Let's call function.
